about_the_game:
Surviving is not enough.

Complete critical missions while endless alien swarms close in from every direction.

Lost Galaxy: Survivors is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter with roguelike action, mission-based gameplay, and long-term progression. Each run drops you into hostile worlds teeming with alien hordes—fight, adapt, complete objectives, and reclaim lost planets one battle at a time.

Key Features

⚔️ Survive Under Pressure
Fight massive alien swarms in fast-paced, skill-based combat where positioning and quick decisions mean the difference between life and death.

🎯 Complete Objectives Mid-Chaos
Install beacons, destroy alien hives, and gather resources—all while enemies relentlessly close in.

💥 Become Unstoppable
Unleash devastating weapons, stack powerful upgrades, and transform overwhelming chaos into total destruction.

🔁 Build Your Loadout Every Run
Choose weapons, perks, and upgrades that evolve your playstyle. Every run offers new builds, new strategies, and new ways to survive.

🌍 Diverse Alien Worlds
Battle across unique biomes, each with distinct enemies, environments, and tactical challenges.

📈 Persistent Progression
Unlock new characters, weapons, and permanent upgrades to push further with every run.

🧠 Strategic Resource Decisions
Invest in immediate survival or long-term power—every choice shapes your next run.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or above
  • Processor: Intel Core i5, Apple Silicon (Rosetta 2 supported)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU (Intel Iris, AMD, Apple M1/M2)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS Tahoe 26 or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3 recommended) or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon integrated or dedicated AMD GPU
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

name: Lost Galaxy: Survivors

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7850, 2GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 or AMD RX 590, 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
